usageGuide.title: OMR Reader — How to Use
usageGuide.subtitle: From exam to report in 6 steps
usageGuide.tipBody: Try a couple of blank forms first. Lighting, printer settings, and camera angle directly affect the result. On the scan screen, hold the phone parallel to the page — capture completes automatically when the green corners light up.

step.classesBody: From the Class Management tab, add your institution, create a class, and enter your students. Give each student a school number — this number is recognized automatically during scanning.
step.templateTitle: Pick or Build an OMR Template
step.templateBody: From the OMR Builder tab, choose a ready-made template (LGS, TYT, AYT) or build your own from scratch. Set question count, choice count, and sections.
step.printBody: Once the template is ready, download the PDF and copy it for each student. The QR code on the form lets the system automatically know which template it belongs to.
step.answerKeyBody: Mark correct answers in the answer key section on the template screen. If there are multiple booklets (A/B/C), define a separate answer key for each.
step.scanBody: After the exam, open your phone and capture the forms one by one from the Scan tab. Align the form with the green corners — the system captures and scores automatically.
step.resultsBody: From the Reports tab, view per-student, per-class, and per-test analysis, item difficulty distribution, and report card outputs. Misread forms can be corrected manually.
